result.fix: Edit the `hosts:` line of `/etc/nsswitch.conf` so `dns` comes before the mDNS source, or remove the mDNS source: `hosts: files dns`. On Ubuntu `apt remove libnss-mdns` removes it.
result.message: `svc.cluster.local` ends in `.local` and `/etc/nsswitch.conf` has an mDNS source with `[NOTFOUND=return]` before `dns`, so it is never sent to a nameserver
notes: `svc.cluster.local` ends in `.local` and `/etc/nsswitch.conf` has an mDNS source with `[NOTFOUND=return]` before `dns`, so it is never sent to a nameserver
The `hosts:` line of `/etc/nsswitch.conf` lists `sss`: every lookup asks sssd first, and a stopped or slow sssd stalls them.
